heap_volume_heightmap — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: image2d × scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.heap_volume_heightmap(hm, pitch: 'float', ground=None) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import granular; granular.heap_volume_heightmap(hm, pitch: 'float', ground=None) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("heap_volume_heightmap"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

高さ図の山の体積 `Σ (z − z_ground) pitch² [m³]。ground` は同形の地面高さ(None = 0)。

負の高さ(地面より下)は 0 に切る —— 穴を山から引き算しない。Raises `ValueError`: 形・pitch。
